_comment: sn3400152764<->sn240324408: 44m near-flat link at ~3450m (glacier plateau). The DEM cross-check wants a 15m drop here, but on-map verification reads the two ends as ~1m apart, so the elevations are left alone and the link is made two-way instead of a one-way piste.
_comment_zermatt_village: n253323900 <-> n240240207: Zermatt village. The runs and paths ending on the Moosstrasse / Zen Steckenstrasse side of the village (16 nodes, incl. the Zmutt ski route) had no link to the Matterhorn Express base 100 m away and 9 m higher, so the whole lower-village side was a trapped basin. Zermatt is car-free and skiers routinely walk or skate the last block between a run-out and a lift station, so this is a flat traverse both ways.

ignoreReversals.why: Checked on the map: the two ends really are ~1 m apart on the glacier plateau, so our near-level orientation is right and the DEM's 15 m drop is wrong.

acceptedBasins.why: Balmbrunnen (Zermatt, 2206-2290 m) is a one-way descent that ends where you stop skiing, not a stranded sector. The run drops off the Riffelboden side and bottoms out at 2206 m with no lift of its own; the cheapest escape is 519 m away and 48 m ABOVE, so nothing could be bridged without inventing an uphill piste. Reviewed on the map by the user: it reads as a ski-in to a hotel at the side of the road, and no link should be added. Signed off rather than fixed.
